ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No, 24-F in the area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to West 103" Street; a line 30 feet west
South State Street; West 103 Street and a line 105 feet west of and
parallel to South State Street,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Aff OL Bet

Anthony Beale
Alderman, 9t Ward

Common Address:
4-8 West 103" Street
